verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-style event pipeline, so a visual audience builder is a fair question for this category, but the evidence shows no such feature. The closest item, Profile Builder, builds warehouse profile records from `identify` traits or custom JavaScript logic. That is adjacent and code-based, not a no-SQL visual audience builder, and nothing in the pack mentions audience-size estimates or audience activation.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating
